title: Apple 10-K Property Plant Equipment
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open Apple Inc.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2014. In that filing, find the line item "Property, plant and equipment, net" and report its value for each of these periods: fiscal 2014 and fiscal 2013. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: Apple Inc.'s fiscal 2014 Form 10-K, Consolidated Balance Sheets, page 47: 'Property, plant and equipment, net' is printed as 20,624 for September 27, 2014 and 16,597 for September 28, 2013.
output.units: In millions, except number of shares which are reflected in thousands and par value
